title: Subspecialty Training in Palliative Medicine
Duration: 3 years full time (competency based): 12 months palliative medicine, 6 months community hospice, 6 months oncology, 12 months fellowship preferably at a recognised overseas centre
Deadline: Non-Malaysians: apply at least 6 months before the training start date; accept offer within 1 month of offer letter
Eligibility: Postgraduate qualification recognised by the Malaysian National Specialist Registry, preferably in a medical specialty (MMed, MRCP); others considered with 24 months internal medicine training; General UMMC requirements: Master's degree/clinical master or equivalent recognised by the Malaysian Medical Council (MMC); registration with MMC; Professional Visit Pass (PLIK) approval; support of Head of Clinical Department; approval by UMMC Credentialing and Privileging Committee
International applicants: Yes - UMMC states its Clinical Fellowship Programme is offered to both local and overseas candidates; non-Malaysian fees apply
Application method: Apply online via the UMMC Fellowship/Training Attachment Programme e-services portal (register and log in)
Funding: Self-funded training fee: non-Malaysian RM36,000 per year (Malaysian RM18,000) plus RM100 management fee, prorated monthly; 15% discount for Lower Middle Income and 30% for Low Income Countries (World Bank)
Visa support: Professional Visit Pass (PLIK) approved by the Immigration Department of Malaysia is a stated requirement
Licence requirement: Registration with the Malaysian Medical Council
Summary: Three-year competency-based subspecialty programme preparing trainees to practise as palliative medicine subspecialists across hospital, community and hospice settings.
